questions.evidenceQuote: Is there any empirical evidence that suggests playfulness is actually good? Swiss psychologist René Proyer has studied adult playfulness more intensely than anyone I know. He found that playfulness is a blend of openness to experience and extraversion, and a relative lack of conscientiousness and neuroticism. It is “an openness to being a fool, which is a combination of not worrying about competence, not being self-important, not taking norms as sacred and finding ambiguity and double edges a source of wisdom and delight.”

questions.prompt: What limits the comparison in 'more intensely than anyone I know'?

options: It is an objective census of every psychologist worldwide.
It ranks every form of adult playfulness by one universal score.
It compares Proyer with the people known to the author.
It claims no one else has ever studied playfulness.
optionsZh: 对全球每位心理学家的客观普查。
按统一分数排名每种成人玩心。
只与作者所认识的人比较 Proyer。
声称其他人从未研究玩心。
analyses: A I know 限个人知识范围，不是全球完整普查。
B 不是给玩心类型打统一排名。
C 限定比较集合，保留作者评价归属。
D 研究更深入不等于别人完全没研究。

vocabulary.meaning: 我认识的任何人；作者熟悉的人群范围

Treating every norm as sacred and every ambiguity as a threat.

Willingness to look silly and find delight or insight in ambiguity.

B not taking norms as sacred 且 ambiguity 可带wisdom,delight。
C double edges 强调多义趣味，不是禁止多义。

他从未与妻子出门。
他说现在每位研究生都和他同样日程。
analyses: A some...when we can 与 haven't...friends for years 给两类对象及频率。
B 研究生时的 almost every day 不能移作近年全体朋友。
C still some 不是 never。
D 自己过去经历不能作为现在所有研究生的统计。

vocabulary.meaning: 有机会时；条件允许时
vocabulary.context: 限定与妻子的部分随兴外出，不是固定每天或从未发生。
vocabulary.example: We take a short walk when we can.
collocations: with my wife when we can

questions.evidenceQuote: Here comes a hard question: When was the last time you went out with someone spontaneously? I still go on some spontaneous outings with my wife when we can, but I haven’t done anything like that with my friends for years. In graduate school, when most of my friends were at school, I would stop by a lab mate’s office and we would go across the street to Espresso Royale for a cup of coffee. Almost every day, I had coffee with someone.

questions.prompt: What did the author do after taking a faculty position in Minnesota?
questions.promptZh: 在 Minnesota 获得教职后，作者做了什么？
options: He booked a formal meeting two weeks ahead before saying hello.
He stopped trying to see colleagues in person.
He moved his colleague's office to a different university.
He dropped by a nearby assistant professor's office and invited him for coffee.
optionsZh: 打招呼前先约两周后的正式会议。
他停止尝试当面见同事。
他把同事办公室移到另一大学。
他顺路去附近助理教授办公室，邀请喝咖啡。
analyses: A 两周后的时间是对方后面提出的，不是作者事前预约。
B dropped by 与停止见面相反。
C 无搬办公室情节。
D 首句拜访加下一句 grab coffee 表明临时互动尝试；不把个人例子变为所有教授的行为。

vocabulary.meaning: 顺路拜访；临时去看看
vocabulary.context: 通常指非正式短访，区别于提前预约两周。
vocabulary.example: I dropped by her office to ask a quick question.

questions.evidenceQuote: When I got a faculty position at the University of Minnesota, I hoped to do the same and dropped by a nearby assistant professor’s office. I knocked on the door and said, “Hi, Bob, do you want to grab coffee?” He said, “Nope. I can’t.

questions.prompt: How is the colleague's 'right now' refusal limited by the following offer?
questions.promptZh: 同事 right now 的拒绝怎样被后面提议限定？
options: He refuses any meeting at any time in the future.
He does not have time immediately but proposes a time two weeks later.
He says the author must wait exactly two years.
He has already agreed to leave immediately without checking a schedule.
optionsZh: 他拒绝未来任何时刻见面。
眼下没时间，但提出两周后的时间。
他说作者必须等整两年。
他没看日程就已同意立即离开。
analyses: A right now 与后面 What about in two weeks 不支持永久拒绝。
B 当下与延后提议形成时点对照。
C two weeks 不是 two years。
D 原文看PDA日程且没有立即去；这是本书2000年9月的个人经历。

vocabulary.meaning: 现在；就在此刻
vocabulary.context: 否定此刻有空，不等于永远没空或从不愿交往。
vocabulary.example: I cannot discuss it right now, but tomorrow may work.

questions.evidenceQuote: I don’t have time right now.” Then he searched his pocket and took out a PDA (this was September 2000), looked at his schedule carefully, and said, “What about in two weeks?” I was stunned. This was what it meant to be a professor as opposed to a graduate student, I thought.

questions.prompt: What does 'I thought' indicate about the professor-versus-student comparison?
questions.promptZh: 教授与研究生的比较里 I thought 表示什么？
options: A controlled survey established the same rule for all professors.
The colleague directly announced a universal scientific result.
The narrator is reporting his own interpretation of the experience.
Every graduate student was formally assigned to avoid appointments.
optionsZh: 控制调查给所有教授建立同一规律。
同事直接宣布普遍科学结论。
叙述者在报告自己对这次经历的理解。
每位研究生被正式安排不要预约。
analyses: A 当前是个人场景，没有这类调查。
B 说话者是 I，不是同事宣读研究。
C 末尾 I thought 限定为作者当时的感想。
D 无正式分派；个案理解不能变成对整个职业的无例外刻板判断。

vocabulary.meaning: 相对于；与……形成对照
vocabulary.context: 在作者感想中比较教授与研究生的时间习惯，不必解释为两类人道德对立。
vocabulary.example: The course emphasises discussion as opposed to memorisation alone.
collocations: professor as opposed to graduate student

questions.evidenceQuote: I don’t have time right now.” Then he searched his pocket and took out a PDA (this was September 2000), looked at his schedule carefully, and said, “What about in two weeks?” I was stunned. This was what it meant to be a professor as opposed to a graduate student, I thought.

questions.prompt: What does 'not just busy but highly protective of their time' add?
questions.promptZh: not just busy but highly protective of their time 补充什么？
options: They have no work and dislike all colleagues.
Being busy and protecting time are the same word with no added meaning.
Every professor has an identical calendar.
In addition to busyness, the author stresses active guarding of available time.
optionsZh: 他们没有工作且讨厌所有同事。
忙与保护时间完全同义，没有增加含义。
每位教授日历完全相同。
在忙之外，作者强调主动保护可用时间。
analyses: A 不由拒绝咖啡推定敌意或没工作。
B not just...but...增加一个侧面。
C 未给全体相同日历。
D 后文资深教授建议 stingy with time 支持主动珍惜时间，不是人人行为一模一样的实测定律。

vocabulary.meaning: 保护、珍惜……的；不轻易让其被占用的
vocabulary.context: 此处对象是时间，不是说教授在身体上保护同事或绝不社交。
vocabulary.example: She is protective of the time reserved for writing.

questions.evidenceQuote: Professors are not just busy but highly protective of their time. A senior professor later advised me to be stingy with my time. Otherwise, I wouldn’t be productive.

questions.prompt: What does 'a highly scheduled time' mean in the paragraph?
questions.promptZh: a highly scheduled time 在本段是什么意思？
options: An era in which activities are heavily organised into calendars.
One precise hour that a clock displays accurately.
A time when no one ever plans anything.
A period with no responsibilities or work meetings.
optionsZh: 活动高度排入日历的时代。
时钟精确显示的某一小时。
没人计划任何事的时期。
没有责任或工作会议的时期。
analyses: A 下一句 Our calendars are packed 解释高度排程的社会状态。
B time 在此为时期时代，不是单个钟点。
C 与 scheduled 方向相反。
D packed 与无责任不符，但仍不能扩大所有人每一天完全相同。

vocabulary.meaning: 被排定的；预先安排好的
vocabulary.context: 描述时代生活的组织倾向，不指某一个特定预约时间。
vocabulary.example: A tightly scheduled week leaves little room for changes.

questions.evidenceQuote: We live in a highly scheduled time. Our calendars are packed, leaving few opportunities for spontaneous activities. The pandemic-era shift to remote work has further limited spontaneous interaction. Pamela Hinds, a professor at Stanford Business School specializing in work teams, collaboration, and innovation, wondered if work teams consisting of people at multiple sites collaborate and innovate at the same rate as work teams where everyone is at a single site.

questions.prompt: What consequence is expressed by 'leaving few opportunities'?
questions.promptZh: leaving few opportunities 表达什么结果？
options: Packed calendars create unlimited unplanned free time.
Only appointments are spontaneous activities.
Full calendars leave limited room for unplanned activity.
No spontaneous event can ever happen to any person.
optionsZh: 满日历创造无限临时空闲。
只有预约才是自发活动。
排满日历给未计划活动留下很少空间。
任何人永远不可能有自发事件。
analyses: A 与 few 相反。
B spontaneous 指非预先安排，不能定义成预约。
C leaving 为前句状态的结果，few 为少而非绝对零。
D few 不能改成 never、anyone，原文仍允许有机会。

vocabulary.meaning: 排得满满的；十分拥挤的
vocabulary.context: 日历语境为行程密集，不是把纸质日历装进箱子。
vocabulary.example: Her calendar was packed with meetings that week.

questions.evidenceQuote: We live in a highly scheduled time. Our calendars are packed, leaving few opportunities for spontaneous activities. The pandemic-era shift to remote work has further limited spontaneous interaction. Pamela Hinds, a professor at Stanford Business School specializing in work teams, collaboration, and innovation, wondered if work teams consisting of people at multiple sites collaborate and innovate at the same rate as work teams where everyone is at a single site.

questions.prompt: What does 'further' imply in the statement about remote work?
questions.promptZh: 远程工作句中的 further 暗示什么？
options: Remote work is the first and only possible limit ever discussed.
It adds to limits on spontaneity already described in the paragraph.
It proves every remote team can never communicate.
It reports the current performance of all companies worldwide.
optionsZh: 远程工作是首次且唯一可能限制。
它在段落已说的自发性限制之外继续增加限制。
证明每个远程团队永不能交流。
报告当前全球所有公司的表现。
analyses: A 前面已有高度排程及满日历。
B further 表递进一步，作者说疫情时期转变加剧限制。
C 限制自发互动不是完全不能交流。
D 是本书时期的论述，非今天全球公司调查；不擅自增加随机因果证明。

vocabulary.meaning: 进一步限制了
vocabulary.context: 保留在已有约束上的增量，不等于归为唯一原因或完全消除互动。
vocabulary.example: The extra requirements further limited the available time.

questions.evidenceQuote: We live in a highly scheduled time. Our calendars are packed, leaving few opportunities for spontaneous activities. The pandemic-era shift to remote work has further limited spontaneous interaction. Pamela Hinds, a professor at Stanford Business School specializing in work teams, collaboration, and innovation, wondered if work teams consisting of people at multiple sites collaborate and innovate at the same rate as work teams where everyone is at a single site.

questions.prompt: Which description preserves the survey's sample boundary?
questions.promptZh: 哪项保留调查样本的边界？
options: Forty-nine multinational companies selected from every industry.
Forty-nine randomly assigned individuals in one classroom.
All remote workers worldwide over the entire pandemic.
Forty-nine R&D teams within one multinational corporation.
optionsZh: 各行业选出的四十九家跨国公司。
一个教室里随机分派的四十九人。
整个疫情期间全球所有远程工作者。
一家跨国公司研发部门的四十九个团队。
analyses: A forty-nine 修饰 teams，single 修饰公司，不能互换数量对象。
B 是团队调查，未说个人随机分派。
C 地点、组织与部门范围都被扩大。
D 研究者Hinds与Mortensen调查单一公司R&D团队，不代表全部企业；只按当前样本说明，不冒称普遍因果。

vocabulary.meaning: 部门；组织内的业务单元
vocabulary.context: research and development division 指研发部门，不是算术除法或四十九家公司。
vocabulary.example: She works in the research division of a large company.
